extracted.intended_audience: corporate communicators, PR agencies, and marketers planning distributed press-release campaigns
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for creating and distributing a Multichannel News Release (MNR): a branded landing page plus multimedia and paid/earned/shares distribution to reach target audiences and drive engagement. Covers package choices (Basic/Standard/Pro) and page features to include.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use a branded landing page (MNR hub)
rubrics_metrics.description: The Multichannel News Release (MNR) is a branded landing page and content distribution solution, which serves as the hub for your multichannel promotion program.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Showcase your content with a custom-branded landing page built by a dedicated team of web designers and project managers; the landing page centralizes multimedia assets, company branding and distribution links.

rubrics_metrics.name: Adopt a paid/owned/shared/earned multichannel strategy
rubrics_metrics.description: Our most popular option combines paid, owned, shared and earned media strategies to help you reach target audiences, drive engagement and promote content.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Elevate messaging from a simple press release to a shareable pitching tool by coupling paid placements, owned landing pages, social/shared distribution, and earned media outreach.

rubrics_metrics.name: Include full press release distribution (wire transmission)
rubrics_metrics.description: Press Release Distribution - Full national wire transmission to 14,500 websites, media outlets and journalists, with international distribution options available as well.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use national wire distribution to maximize reach to media outlets and journalists; consider international options if targeting global audiences.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provide multiple multimedia assets
rubrics_metrics.description: Multimedia Assets - Display up to 6 multimedia assets.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include images, videos, audio, PDFs and other assets to enrich the release; Standard allows up to 6 assets (Basic allows 3).

rubrics_metrics.name: Offer choice of influencer/target lists
rubrics_metrics.description: Choice of Influencer List - We can distribute the MNR to an additional Cision Influencer list.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Select influencer lists to target industry-specific journalists, bloggers and social influencers for more focused outreach.

rubrics_metrics.name: Integrate lead-generation and calls-to-action
rubrics_metrics.description: Lead Generation/Call-to-Action - Integrate your own or have one built for your calls-to-action; click-throughs to your site, social channels and more.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Design CTAs and lead-capture elements on the landing page to convert traffic into measurable actions (newsletter signups, downloads, site visits).

rubrics_metrics.name: Purchase guaranteed page views
rubrics_metrics.description: Guaranteed Page Views - 10,000 Guaranteed Page Views (Standard) / 5,000 Guaranteed Page Views (Basic).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use guaranteed views driven by contextual audience targeting to ensure minimum exposure; choose Basic vs Standard based on view guarantees required.

rubrics_metrics.name: Include online video distribution
rubrics_metrics.description: Online Video Distribution - Distribution of one video file to top video portals (YouTube, Vimeo and AP Video Hub).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Distribute video assets to major portals to increase visibility and embed video on the MNR landing page for engagement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use Guaranteed Paid Placement for premium publisher coverage
rubrics_metrics.description: Guaranteed Paid Placement guarantees coverage in top online media outlets to tell powerful brand stories directly on publisher sites in your industry target.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Couple MNR with Guaranteed Paid Placement (MNR Pro) to secure placements on sites unreachable by wire alone; combines earned and paid distribution to deliver editorial-style content on target publishers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Choose package level appropriate to goals (Basic / Standard / Pro)
rubrics_metrics.description: Package options: Basic MNR (budget-friendly) includes 5,000 guaranteed page views, 3 multimedia assets, press release distribution, lead generation, influencer list and a branded landing page; Standard and Pro add higher guarantees and paid placement.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Select Basic for lower budgets and fewer assets/guarantees; Standard for broader reach and more assets; Pro when you need guaranteed paid placements on premium publisher sites.

rubrics_metrics.name: Enable autoplay video to boost engagement
rubrics_metrics.description: Autoplay Video - Drive views and engagement with automatically playing video clips on page load.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use autoplay judiciously to increase immediate view counts and engagement, but consider user experience and mobile data constraints.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use interactive image animations (mouseovers)
rubrics_metrics.description: Mouseovers - Dynamic image animations that encourage clicks and engagement.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Add hover/animation effects to images to prompt exploration and clicks, improving on-page engagement metrics.

rubrics_metrics.name: Structure content with content blocks
rubrics_metrics.description: Content Blocks - Layout for mixed media content – text and assets. Great for posting event calendars, food menus.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Organize the landing page into modular content blocks for readability and to present different asset types coherently.

rubrics_metrics.name: Add page-load animations to encourage scrolling
rubrics_metrics.description: Page Load Animations - Fades, slide-in animation encourage the visitor to scroll through the page.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use subtle animations to guide visitor attention and reduce bounce rates; balance with performance considerations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use animated infographics for data storytelling
rubrics_metrics.description: Animated Infographics - Animate static data into a wide variety of animated displays for bar graphs, line graphs, pie charts, and more.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Turn static statistics into animated visuals to make data more engaging and easier to understand.

rubrics_metrics.name: Match branding with custom icons and buttons
rubrics_metrics.description: Custom Icons - We now have play buttons social share buttons that match the client’s brand.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Customize icons and social buttons to align with brand identity and improve cohesive presentation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Font matching for consistent visual identity
rubrics_metrics.description: Font matching - Ability to use client provided fonts to tailor the look and feel of the page.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Apply client fonts to maintain brand consistency across the landing page and assets.
